description: This file defines the MessageSourceService interface, which extends MutableMessageSource and provides methods for retrieving and managing message sources and messages within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: MessageSourceService
classes.description: An interface for a service that extends MutableMessageSource with additional capabilities for managing message sources and retrieving localized messages.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message associated with the given code for the current user's locale.

methods.name: getActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Returns the message source currently providing services.

methods.name: setActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Sets the message source service that will provide messaging services.

methods.name: getMessageSources
methods.description: Returns the set of available message sources.
